    Bug 2013955 - set min-height for newFolderDialog (to fix intermittent test failures). r=arschmitz
    
    
    Should not be able to resize below this height.
    Better to use rem, so font scaling adjusts as needed.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D285984

diff --git a/mail/base/test/browser/menus/browser_folderPaneContext.js b/mail/base/test/browser/menus/browser_folderPaneContext.js
index a66aee33ce7..3170138f914 100644
--- a/mail/base/test/browser/menus/browser_folderPaneContext.js
+++ b/mail/base/test/browser/menus/browser_folderPaneContext.js
@@ -290,7 +290,7 @@ add_task(async function testNewRenameDelete() {
 
         Assert.greaterOrEqual(
           win.innerWidth,
-          300,
+          235,
           "new folder dialog should have reasonable width"
         );
         Assert.greaterOrEqual(
diff --git a/mailnews/base/content/newFolderDialog.xhtml b/mailnews/base/content/newFolderDialog.xhtml
index a749cbf338a..b978a20e896 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/content/newFolderDialog.xhtml
+++ b/mailnews/base/content/newFolderDialog.xhtml
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
   xmlns:xul="http://www.mozilla.org/keymaster/gatekeeper/there.is.only.xul"
   xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"
   lightweightthemes="true"
-  style="min-width: 310px; height: 200px"
+  style="min-width: 20rem; min-height: 12.5rem"
   scrolling="false"
 >
   <head>
